name: com.whichdateworks/whichdateworks
title: WhichDateWorks
description: Group date polls: plan with friends, family or co-workers and find a date that works for everyone.

tools.name: create_poll
tools.description: Make plans with friends, family, co-workers or any group: create a poll of candidate dates or times, and everyone marks which ones work for them, so the group can find a date or time that works for everyone. For example a dinner, a trip, game night, a team lunch, an offsite or a meeting. Use when the user is planning something with other people and hasn't settled on a date. Returns a link to share with the group and a private link for the organizer. Pass either `dates` (all-day options) or `times` (time slots with the user's `timeZone`), all in the future. Pass `organizerName` (the user's first name) when you know it. Give the user both links: `inviteUrl` to share with the group, and `manageUrl`, which only they should have.

title.description: What the event is, e.g. "Dinner with Sam and Alex".

dates.description: All-day options as YYYY-MM-DD calendar days, up to 100. Use this or `times`, not both.

times.description: Time slot options, up to 100. Use this or `dates`, not both.

start.description: Start as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm, like 2026-12-05T19:00. Without an offset it is wall clock time in `timeZone`.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone the times are in, usually the user's, like "America/New_York". Required with `times` unless every time has an offset. Each participant sees the times in their own zone.

duration.description: Default length of each time slot in minutes. Defaults to 60.

location.description: Where it happens, as free text.

organizerName.description: The user's first name, if you know it. The poll shows it as the host.

tools.name: get_poll_results
tools.description: See how people voted on a WhichDateWorks poll and which option is winning. Pass the poll's id or its invite link to see what the public poll page shows: if the organizer hid scores or participant names, they stay hidden. Pass its manageUrl instead to get the organizer's view, with every name and count. Don't share hidden names with people other than the organizer.

inviteUrl.description: The poll's invite link, if you don't have its id.

manageUrl.description: The poll's manageUrl, if that's the link you have. Gives the organizer's view: every name and count, even ones hidden from guests.

tools.name: add_options
tools.description: Add more candidate dates or times to a WhichDateWorks poll the user organizes, for example when the group asks for another weekend. Pass the poll's manageUrl from create_poll, and `dates` for a poll of all-day dates or `times` for a poll of time slots, all in the future. Options the poll already has are skipped. Everyone who already voted keeps their votes and can vote on the new options.

manageUrl.description: The poll's manageUrl from create_poll (https://app.whichdateworks.com/claim/…), or the token at its end. The invite link won't work here.

dates.description: All-day options to add, as YYYY-MM-DD, for a poll of dates. The poll can have up to 100 options in all.

times.description: Time slots to add, for a poll of times. The poll can have up to 100 options in all.

start.description: Start as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm, like 2026-12-05T19:00. Without an offset it is wall clock time in `timeZone`.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone the times are in. Defaults to the poll's own time zone.

duration.description: Default length of each time slot in minutes. Defaults to 60.

tools.name: close_poll
tools.description: Stop the voting on a WhichDateWorks poll the user organizes, for example once everyone has answered. Pass the poll's manageUrl from create_poll. Returns the leading option so you can tell the user. Picking the final date and notifying everyone happens on the website: the organizer opens manageUrl and signs in.

manageUrl.description: The poll's manageUrl from create_poll (https://app.whichdateworks.com/claim/…), or the token at its end. The invite link won't work here.
